title: 2025/26 Maha Paddy Purchasing Programme
content: The Paddy Marketing Board circular PMB/OP/Paddy Pur./2025/26 Maha -02 dated 26 January 2026 provides instructions for purchasing paddy during the 2025/26 Maha season.

title: Maximum Moisture Requirement
content: For paddy accepted under the 2025/26 Maha Paddy Marketing Board purchasing programme, the maximum moisture percentage is 14 percent.

title: Maximum Admixture Requirement
content: The maximum permitted admixture percentage under the PMB 2025/26 Maha purchasing quality requirements is 1 percent.

title: Maximum Variety Mixture
content: The maximum permitted mixture of different paddy varieties under the PMB 2025/26 Maha purchasing programme is 6 percent.

title: Maximum Broken or Empty Grain Requirement
content: The PMB 2025/26 Maha quality requirements specify a maximum broken or empty grain quantity of 9 percent by volume.

title: Damaged and Contaminated Paddy
content: Paddy supplied to the PMB must be free from discoloured grains, insect-damaged grains, insect eggs, insects and their life-cycle stages.

title: Paddy Rejected for Quality Reasons
content: When paddy does not comply with the required PMB quality standards, the rejection should be recorded on the farmer information form. The farmer may prepare the paddy to meet the approved standards and present it again for consideration.

title: PMB Nadu Purchasing Price
content: For the 2025/26 Maha season, the Paddy Marketing Board purchasing price stated in the circular for Nadu paddy, white or red, is Rs. 120.00 per kilogram.

title: PMB Samba Purchasing Price
content: For the 2025/26 Maha season, the Paddy Marketing Board purchasing price stated in the circular for Samba paddy, white or red, is Rs. 130.00 per kilogram.

title: PMB Keeri Samba Purchasing Price
content: For the 2025/26 Maha season, the Paddy Marketing Board purchasing price stated in the circular for Keeri Samba is Rs. 140.00 per kilogram.

title: Standard Farmer Purchasing Quantity
content: Under the 2025/26 Maha purchasing instructions, one farmer information form may normally be used to purchase up to 2,500 kilograms of paddy from one farmer.

title: Extended Farmer Purchasing Quantity
content: Where the required facilities can be provided without difficulty, the quantity purchased from one farmer may be increased up to 5,000 kilograms according to the instructions of the Regional Manager.

title: Direct Purchasing from Farmers
content: The PMB 2025/26 Maha circular describes direct purchasing of paddy from farmers at Paddy Marketing Board warehouses, subject to the specified quality requirements.

title: Payment Through Bank
content: Payments for paddy purchased under the programme are made through the bank directly to the account of the person who supplies the paddy to the warehouse. The supplier must provide a bank account number.

title: Paddy Bag Weight
content: When paddy is delivered to PMB warehouses in bags, the purchasing instructions refer to a 50 kilogram paddy bag with an allowed weight variation of 250 grams.
